Players Committee card image of [[FN-2003 (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Once per turn, if with your First Order trooper, may use 1 Force to target opponent's character present (free if Finn) and make FN-2003 'hit;' for remainder of turn, target's game text is canceled and target may not fire weapons.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/fn2003.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
